title: Commander
description: The player's chain of command (GDD §11): the two recurring voices behind `say`/`dispatch`/`aftermath`/`debrief`, and the rank the HUD shows for the current mission. Data, not engine code -- a promotion is a new row, not a new build.

people.description: The two named voices `say.speaker` can attribute a line to. `net` and `enemy` are not people on this roster -- the HUD names them literally (NET, ENEMY) rather than looking them up here.

ranks.description: In ascending campaign order. The rank for a given mission is the first entry whose until_mission is that mission or later in campaign order (world.json's town arrays, regions in order). The last entry carries no until_mission and is the default for everything after it -- validate_data.mjs enforces both the ordering and that only the last entry omits the field.

until_mission.description: Mission id (data/missions, campaign order) this rank holds through. Omit only on the last entry.

plate.description: Short name for the commander bar / speaker label.

portrait.description: File name (not a path) under assets/ui/portraits/, e.g. "shai_hammai.png". Optional -- a person with none shows the `.rl-cmd__face` hatch, exactly like one whose named file is not on disk yet.
